title: Sales
learning_outcomes: Explain customer problems in the context of sales.
Compare and distinguish ethical discovery in the context of sales.
Apply value proposition in the context of sales.
Evaluate and justify decisions about objections in the context of sales.

lessons.title: Customer problems
lessons.outcome: Explain customer problems in the context of sales.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving customer problems; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to sales role-play.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain customer problems from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of customer problems; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Ethical discovery
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish ethical discovery in the context of sales.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving ethical discovery; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to sales role-play.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain ethical discovery from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of ethical discovery; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Value proposition
lessons.outcome: Apply value proposition in the context of sales.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving value proposition; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to sales role-play.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain value proposition from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of value proposition; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Objections
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about objections in the context of sales.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving objections; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to sales role-play.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain objections from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of objections; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of customer problems; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of ethical discovery; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of value proposition; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of objections; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practitioner with relevant business, technology or privacy expertise.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
